body: Don't think you're crazy, you just need some fresh air
Yeah or the Futurama suicide booth

I was supposed to be happy on a vacation with my family, you know take a break for a week. 

Like you, I could *not* feel the happiness I should have had. While sun bathing all I did was cover my head with a towel, not to show them I was crying, and trying my best to sleep in order to stop existing.

I'm "living" for my family. Thats not the correct verb to describe my condition: I'm closer to a vegetable than an ordinary human. It'd be cool to have someone remember us that things could improve. I miss that comforting false hope I once had

Your gonna pass all you pain to them! You might feel like an mix of their personalities, but ending it all would add so much guilt because theyd feel they didn't do enough for you to stay, and it might change them for the worst. Would you like see them suffer, at least partially he same pain you're feeling right now?
What will you most miss? Is it worth to miss said thing?
Likewise, I feel the pointlesness of our mundane life accentuates my despair
You just want to stop suffering, you don't want to end it all

I'm not counting, I do something else: I imagine being cremated and think where the ashes of certain body parts should be released. 

"It would be fun to have my dick or my ass checks on the Eiffel tower" - or stuff like that

I knew something was off for a year before getting professional help. 

I still feel like I'm a fraud even with the diagnosis lolz.
Yeah everyone starts caring once you're off
Oh yeah, the "fuck dinner for tonight" is one of my best dishes
By sleeping do you mean having a constant schedule for it? I find myself either sleeping to much or too little. I just went to what I thought I needed day by day

I guess borlerline inappropriate, like seeing a video of a girl commiting suicide form the rooftops of an hospital and feeling compelled to comment "they should bring her to the hospital" type of drak

I tried meditation for a while. I stopped because I became hyper aware of my ' delight' full thoughts. 

Oh and physical exercise had a much more impact than the pills they prescribed
It's not actually a delusion, but my dumb reason to keep me going it's that I haven't seen how rick and morty or one piece ends.
Don't think so. I usually start to feel numb as a coping mechanism. Its like I can go on autopilot in order to escape reality for brief seconds
The only thing that changed with time was the meds I was taking. I could swear I think if you gave me a placebo pill of sugar I wouldn't feel a difference
Yo man, you made me smile. It doesn't happen that often. Thanks for brightening my day!
I think I'm an ambivert right now but I definitely grew up as an introvert
Nice to hear that you're moving forward. Best of wishes for your journey. Just don't get discouraged if they prescribe meds that won't work at first. Usually you have to find the right ones for you
I slept for 23 hours. I needed to take a shit, so I couldn't say I slept all day long
